data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end. This favourable loss development is spread across multiple classes of business and years of account and is caused by both attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated and improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves. The most significant favourable development occurred on the 2012 year of account and related to the Property (Direct & Facultative) class.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development on the 2012 year of account related to the Property (Direct & Facultative) class, leading to improvements in claims reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a prior-year favourable development (release) primarily reflected as a net improvement of GBP 6.4m in prior claims reserves. Management attributes this to generally benign catastrophe experience, lower-than-expected attritional and large loss activity and improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves, with the most notable improvement occurring on the 2012 year of account in Property (Direct & Facultative). A gross prior-year movement figure is not provided in the notes, so the quantified figure reported is net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: a generally benign catastrophe year, combined with lower than expected attritional and large loss activity has meant that both the 2014 and 2013 years of account continue to develop favourably.
